learnerPresentation.initialPresentation: A 49-year-old patient presents with sudden pain in the front of the elbow after lifting a heavy box yesterday. He felt a distinct “pop” in the antecubital fossa at the time of injury. Over the past 24 hours, bruising has developed around the front of the elbow. He reports weakness when turning the palm upwards and when bending the elbow. Pain is 5/10 at rest and increases to 8/10 with lifting or resisted supination. He wants to know whether this needs urgent onward referral.

neutralTitle: Sudden anterior elbow pain after lifting
